title: Yoeleo Altera G21 Panda Podium Purple frameset
notes: Current named product page lists US$1,420, 1,170 g painted and 1,150 g raw frame weights for size 56, a 480 g painted fork, a 95.2 g seatpost without clamp, the full 45–60 geometry table, T47 85.5 mm, UDH, 53 mm clearance only for a single-chainring setup, 1×42T/44T and 2×50/34T-with-washer limits, and a six-year warranty. Its weight basis conflicts with the older official size-49 980 ±50 g guide and is preserved separately.
